objective: Fix screenshot-confirmed Genesis Cluster directory/Organization+Cluster Community Wall empty backgrounds, and align capped reader avatars with room-cursor time in Connect.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current owner screenshots and repository Genesis staging release-candidate source commit 93420f23a016fecd341a15c6f05a75ab691f3203 were inspected 2026-11-20. Live production Android OTA, runtime and manifest were NOT verified and production was not changed. This is DEV-only staging PR.
chosenApproach: Reuse bundled GenesisCosmosBackground with focus-aware ambient motion; make only Genesis scoped Wall scrolling surfaces transparent over existing cosmic scene. Use current authenticated room reader cursor with bounded, non-overlapping avatar slots; no backend or native changes.
selectionRationale: Existing Genesis sky was covered by opaque feed canvas. Existing Seen avatar margin-right:-6 plus oversized rank/note overlays caused collision. Backend read cursor already provides authorized room last-read timestamps; do not synthesize per-message receipts.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Improve the background and Connect Seen appearance in the existing Genesis Android JavaScript runtime without native dependency changes.
preservedBehaviors: Existing offline Cluster directory, ad placement, push/navigation and production channel stay untouched.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Restore readable Seen avatars and display the latest authorized room-read cursor on existing Connect messages.
preservedBehaviors: No fabricated read acknowledgments, message history edits, call/PTT or backend permission changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Restore Galaxy Creation visuals behind Cluster and Organization scoped Wall while preserving existing content rendering.
preservedBehaviors: No changed scope membership access, Scripture/Proverbs logic, ads, Wall post writes, video lifecycle or photo media.

preserveBehaviors: Legacy non-Genesis canvases and signed native APK remain unchanged.
Live data, RLS, ad placements and first-view ad lifecycle remain unchanged.
Direct messages, scope cursor RPC and messages continue existing behavior.
alternativeApproaches: Change the global BuklodThemeProvider palette (rejected: would recolor all routes and cause contrast regressions).
Add a new receipt table/RPC and overlays (rejected: unnecessary backend writes, security and performance cost).
Use high-frequency SVG overlays on every Wall card (rejected: expensive on Android scrolling).
acceptanceChecks: Run exact PR scope and protected-feature CI gates with changed Node and Jest tests.
Run TypeScript and focused Jest tests where supported.
Verify Android Galaxy background, scroll performance, ad first-view/navigation and reader receipts with authorized test member account before publication.
Verify staging native build/runtime/channel parity and production manifest unchanged before any OTA.
releaseTarget: Genesis staging Android preview only, never production from this PR
